theme: Light & Dark Editorial Mode with Cream, Jet Black, Terracotta & Warm Taupe Accents
components: Navbar with official logo, category links, search trigger, cart drawer trigger, and admin access
Editorial Hero Section with immersive imagery, brand tagline, and CTA
Brand Story / Essence Section highlighting modern, urban, feminine & masculine styling
Inspiration Categories grid with clear 'Próximamente' badges
Featured Editorial Product Showcase (Próximamente / Catalog Ready)
Full Catalog & Category Filter system (Mujer, Hombre, Aros, Collares, Anillos, Pulseras, Dijes, Accesorios)
Interactive Functional Cart Drawer with Subtotal, Total, Quantity modifier, and Checkout Simulation
Comprehensive Admin Dashboard for non-technical users to manage products, categories, stock, prices, variants, and editorial flags (Nuevo, Destacado, Oferta)
universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds on headers or sticky menus; use rich glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-zinc-950/80 with subtle borders)
Apply generous spacing (p-8, p-12, gap-8) for an editorial luxury feel
Ensure all buttons and inputs have clear hover, focus, and active contrast states
Do not invent commercial prices or stock on store load; use clean Próximamente / Catalog Ready structure ready for real management via Admin
